tools.name: get_github_file
tools.description: Get file content from a GitHub repository. Returns the file content with metadata including SHA, size, and line range.

tools.name: list_github_directory
tools.description: List directory contents in a GitHub repository. Returns files and subdirectories with their metadata.

tools.name: create_github_branch
tools.description: Create a new branch in a GitHub repository. Fails if the branch already exists.

tools.name: diagnose_text_payload
tools.description: Diagnostic: reports metadata of a received text payload (character_count, utf8_byte_count, sha256, marker checks). Use this to verify ChatGPT is not truncating tool call arguments when committing large files.

tools.name: commit_github_files
tools.description:
Commit one or more files to a GitHub repository. All files go into a single commit.
Each file must have: path, operation (upsert/delete), content, optional expected_sha.
Optional pull_request object: create, base_branch, title, body.

tools.name: create_github_pull_request
tools.description: Create a pull request on GitHub between two branches.

tools.name: list_ci_workers
tools.description: List GitHub repository self-hosted Actions runners. Returns runner name, status, OS, and labels. NOT for private CI workers (use list_private_ci_workers).

tools.name: list_ci_profiles
tools.description: List GitHub Actions workflow definitions. Returns workflow name, state, and URL. NOT for private CI profiles (use list_private_ci_profiles).

tools.name: list_ci_jobs
tools.description: List GitHub Actions workflow runs. Can filter by workflow_id, branch, or status. NOT for private CI jobs (use list_private_ci_jobs).

tools.name: start_ci_job
tools.description: Trigger a GitHub Actions workflow_dispatch workflow. Requires workflow_id and a ref (branch/tag). NOT for private CI (use start_private_ci_job).

tools.name: get_ci_job
tools.description: Get details of a GitHub Actions workflow run by run_id. NOT for private CI jobs (use get_private_ci_job).

tools.name: get_ci_logs
tools.description: Get GitHub Actions workflow run logs. NOT for private CI logs (use get_private_ci_logs).

tools.name: cancel_ci_job
tools.description: Cancel a GitHub Actions workflow run by run_id. NOT for private CI jobs (use cancel_private_ci_job).

tools.name: get_github_repository
tools.description: Get metadata about a GitHub repository including default branch, language, stars, and merge settings.

tools.name: list_github_branches
tools.description: List branches in a GitHub repository with optional protected_only filter, pagination support.

tools.name: get_github_branch
tools.description: Get details of a specific branch including commit SHA and optional comparison with base branch.

tools.name: get_github_commit
tools.description: Get details of a specific commit by SHA including author, stats, changed files, and verification status.

tools.name: compare_github_commits
tools.description: Compare two commits, branches, or tags showing ahead/behind, changed files, and commit list.

tools.name: list_github_pull_requests
tools.description: List pull requests in a repository with filters for state, branch, sort order, and pagination.

tools.name: get_github_pull_request
tools.description: Get detailed information about a specific pull request including mergeability, reviews, and stats.

tools.name: list_github_pull_request_files
tools.description: List files changed in a pull request with optional patch content and pagination.

tools.name: update_github_pull_request
tools.description: Update a PR's title, body, state, or base branch. Supports expected_head_sha for concurrency protection. Cannot merge PRs.

tools.name: get_github_pull_request_checks
tools.description: Get check runs and commit statuses for the PR's current head SHA. Returns overall conclusion and per-check details.

tools.name: list_github_pull_request_comments
tools.description: List comments on a pull request (issue comments and review comments) with pagination.

tools.name: create_github_pull_request_comment
tools.description: Create a comment on a pull request. Supports expected_head_sha for concurrency protection.

tools.name: get_github_pull_request_merge_readiness
tools.description: Aggregate safe PR merge readiness: exact head SHA, reviews, GitHub Checks, repository merge methods, and private CI gate.

tools.name: get_github_pull_request_conflicts
tools.description: Read-only PR conflict diagnosis. Never updates the branch or force-pushes.

tools.name: plan_github_pull_request_merge
tools.description: Read-only merge preflight with exact SHA, review, Checks, private CI, and merge-method gates. Never merges.

tools.name: merge_github_pull_request
tools.description: Safely merge a PR only after readiness gates, exact SHA, passed private CI, and explicit confirm=true. Never deploys.

tools.name: mark_github_pull_request_ready
tools.description: Convert a draft PR to ready-for-review with exact head SHA protection.

tools.name: convert_github_pull_request_to_draft
tools.description: Convert an open PR to draft with exact head SHA protection.

tools.name: update_github_pull_request_branch
tools.description: Request GitHub's official update-branch operation; never force-pushes locally.

tools.name: list_github_pull_request_reviews
tools.description: List submitted PR reviews, distinct from requested reviewers.

tools.name: request_github_pull_request_reviewers
tools.description: Request user and team reviewers with exact head SHA protection.

tools.name: remove_github_pull_request_reviewers
tools.description: Remove requested user and team reviewers with exact head SHA protection.

tools.name: delete_github_branch
tools.description: Delete a non-default, non-protected branch only with exact SHA and confirm=true. Never follows merge automatically.

tools.name: plan_test_deployment
tools.description: Plan only a fullstack frankichen/sxt gongshi-test deployment; validates exact main SHA, private CI, changed files, migrations, and infrastructure changes.

tools.name: start_test_deployment
tools.description: Queue a whitelist-only fullstack gongshi-test deployment after exact main SHA and passed main private CI gates. Requires confirm=true; never accepts host or shell input.

tools.name: get_test_deployment
tools.description: Get a deployment status by deployment_id; deployment_id is distinct from CI job_id and GitHub Actions run_id.

tools.name: get_test_deployment_logs
tools.description: Read redacted paginated deployment logs by deployment_id.

tools.name: wait_test_deployment
tools.description: Long-poll deployment metadata for up to 55 seconds without returning logs or lease tokens.

tools.name: get_test_deployment_log_tail
tools.description: Read a redacted deployment log tail without returning lease tokens.

tools.name: list_test_deployments
tools.description: List whitelist-only gongshi-test deployments with filters and pagination.

tools.name: cancel_test_deployment
tools.description: Cancel a queued deployment immediately or request safe cancellation at a worker boundary.

tools.name: get_test_environment_status
tools.description: Get redacted gongshi-test environment and health summary; never returns env values or credentials.

tools.name: list_test_releases
tools.description: List verified gongshi-test release summaries without reading env files.

tools.name: rollback_test_deployment
tools.description: Queue a whitelist-only rollback after current-release and checksum gates. Never runs goose down or deletes data/releases.

tools.name: list_github_commits
tools.description: Query commit history in a repository by time range. Filters by author/identity, excludes bots and merge commits by default. Supports pagination.

tools.name: search_github_pull_request_history
tools.description: Search PR history across repositories by identity, time range, and activity type (authored/updated/merged/reviewed/commented).

tools.name: list_github_review_history
tools.description: List code reviews performed by an identity across repositories in a time range.

tools.name: list_github_issue_history
tools.description: List issues an identity participated in across repositories. Excludes pull requests from results.

tools.name: get_github_development_history
tools.description: Get aggregated development history (commits, PRs, reviews, issues, CI runs, open work) for an identity across repositories in a time range. Ideal for daily/weekly/monthly reports.

tools.name: get_github_weekly_report_data
tools.description: Get structured data for a weekly development report. Includes completed work, work in progress, code reviews, CI quality, risks, and next-week candidates.

tools.name: get_mygithub_capabilities
tools.description: Return the explicit MyGithub10 capability and compatibility contract.

tools.name: get_github_file_manifest
tools.description: Return exact Git Blob metadata for a file without returning file content.

tools.name: read_github_file_chunk
tools.description: Read an exact UTF-8 byte chunk with SHA and continuation metadata.

tools.name: open_github_file_resource
tools.description: Open a file resource handle for paginated reads instead of returning a large JSON body.

tools.name: read_github_file_resource
tools.description: Read a bounded page from an opened MyGithub10 file resource.

tools.name: apply_github_patch
tools.description: Apply a strict unified diff atomically with exact HEAD/blob checks and optional dry-run/idempotency.

tools.name: edit_github_file_ranges
tools.description: Apply non-overlapping, hash-checked line range edits as one atomic commit.

tools.name: begin_github_file_upload
tools.description: Begin a bounded, permission-0600 chunked file upload.

tools.name: append_github_file_upload_chunk
tools.description: Append one contiguous SHA-checked upload chunk.

tools.name: finalize_github_file_upload
tools.description: Finalize an upload only after exact size and SHA256 validation.

tools.name: commit_github_uploaded_files
tools.description: Commit one finalized upload to a branch with exact HEAD/blob checks.

tools.name: abort_github_file_upload
tools.description: Abort and remove only the selected temporary upload.

tools.name: create_attestation_for_passed_job
tools.description: Create a Tree SHA attestation from server-side CI evidence; callers may only choose job_id and bounded expiry.

tools.name: get_attestation
tools.description: Read a persisted Tree SHA attestation by id.

tools.name: validate_attestation
tools.description: Validate every identity, job, toolchain, dependency, config, expiry and revocation gate before CI reuse.

tools.name: revoke_attestation
tools.description: Revoke one persisted attestation so it can never be reused.

tools.name: build_release_artifact
tools.description: Build and register an artifact only from server-controlled source storage and a valid attestation; callers cannot provide hashes, paths, status or identity evidence.

tools.name: get_release_artifact
tools.description: Read one registered artifact without exposing arbitrary filesystem contents.

tools.name: list_release_artifacts
tools.description: List registered artifact metadata by repository and status.

tools.name: validate_release_artifact
tools.description: Validate artifact readiness, expiry, provenance, exact main identity and current private CI status.

tools.name: revoke_release_artifact
tools.description: Revoke a registered artifact; revoked artifacts cannot be deployed.

tools.name: get_repository_operation_policy
tools.description: Read the server-owned allowlist for a repository; it cannot be widened by MCP parameters.

tools.name: list_private_ci_workers
tools.description:
List workers registered with the private CI controller, including wsl-ci-01.

Returns each worker's ID, online status, supported profiles, max concurrency, and current job.

This is for the private German-controller + WSL-Podman CI system.
NOT for GitHub Actions self-hosted runners (use list_ci_workers for that).

tools.name: list_private_ci_profiles
tools.description:
List available CI profiles for the private CI system.

Returns profiles like repo-auto-check, python-check, etc.
Use these profile names with start_private_ci_job.

This is for the private CI system. NOT for GitHub Actions workflows (use list_ci_profiles for that).

tools.name: list_private_ci_jobs
tools.description:
List private CI jobs with optional filters.

Use this to find jobs for a specific repository, branch, commit SHA, or status.
Jobs are executed by wsl-ci-01 on the WSL machine with Rootless Podman.

This is for the private CI system. NOT for GitHub Actions runs (use list_ci_jobs for that).

tools.name: start_private_ci_job
tools.description:
Start a job in the private German-controller and WSL-Podman CI system for an exact Git commit SHA.

CRITICAL WORKFLOW:
1. After committing code via commit_github_files, save the commit_sha
2. Call start_private_ci_job with the FULL 40-character commit_sha
3. Save the returned job_id
4. Use get_private_ci_job to check the job status
5. Use get_private_ci_logs to read logs if the job failed

This is for the private WSL CI system. NOT for GitHub Actions dispatch (use start_ci_job for that).

tools.name: get_private_ci_job
tools.description:
Get the current status and details of a specific private CI job by job_id.

Returns complete job information including status, queue_position, current_step, exit_code, steps array, and timestamps.

This is for the private CI system. NOT for GitHub Actions runs (use get_ci_job for that).

tools.name: wait_private_ci_job
tools.description: Long-poll one private CI job for up to 55 seconds. Returns on status, step, log revision, terminal, or timeout; use instead of repeated polling.

tools.name: get_private_ci_logs
tools.description:
Get private CI job execution logs by job_id. Supports pagination for large logs.

Use the exact job_id from start_private_ci_job. Do NOT assume the latest job's logs.

This is for the private CI system. NOT for GitHub Actions logs (use get_ci_logs for that).

tools.name: get_private_ci_log_tail
tools.description: Return the redacted tail of a private CI job log without requiring the caller to page through the full log.

tools.name: cancel_private_ci_job
tools.description:
Cancel a private CI job by job_id.

- For queued jobs: immediately cancels
- For running jobs: sends cancel signal to the worker
- For completed jobs: returns current status (cannot cancel)

This is for the private CI system. NOT for GitHub Actions (use cancel_ci_job for that).
